skipped.reason: Partly skipped: I did not add 'Depends on: M1-T02' to M1-T03, because both are interface tasks and an edge between interface tasks is banned. The tests/contracts/api.* samples are frozen contract fixtures, so I put the api.* types on M1-T03's Read line instead and added no edge. The rest is applied: the fake.ts path is in Writes and the acceptance now says the PL-12 and PL-14 route modules.

Partly skipped: I did not make M1-T13–M1-T15 depend on M1-T12. That would be a spine-to-spine edge, which is banned. It is also not needed: those tasks build against M1-T01's PitReader replay double, and M1-T12 delegates to the step stubs M1-T01 writes. The rest is applied: the delegation invariant, M1-T12's acceptance and its Read additions.

Partly skipped: I could not regenerate tests/fixtures/qfcst/TC-72/input.json (planted Sharpe is still 3.0), because only expected.json may be edited. The Source and Tolerance in tests.md now say Sharpe 5.0, and the regeneration is routed to test-planning.

It is a value computed from a binomial at α = 0.05, so under the rules I removed the stale 'at most 1 of 20' from Expected and from expected.json and routed it to test-planning to re-derive. TC-19's Expected and Tolerance no longer contradict each other.

Partly skipped: tests/fixtures/qfeat/TC-30/input.json still has history_days 200, because I can't edit input.json. I also removed volume shock, idiosyncratic volatility and beta from TC-30's expected values, since whether they have values for the new member has to be re-derived. Both are routed to test-planning.
